summary: Executed P0 remediation verification across backend + frontend. Added/ran fresh P0 regression tests for outbound hardening and local-first privacy gates, reran key Gate suites, and completed mobile web regression navigation (390x844) across onboarding/home/guard/patrol/check/message/email/account/file without runtime crashes.

minor.issue: Legacy tests expecting 200/4xx now fail with 403 due enforced local-first PrivacyBoundary (intentional behavior).
Test setup can build invalid relative URL '/api/...' when backend URL env is missing in pytest worker context (test bug, not API behavior).

issues: Console warning observed: deprecated shadow* style props (non-blocking).

action_items: Main agent: retire/update obsolete backend suites that still assume pre-P0 cloud processing for raw message/page/inbox/caller/breach flows.
Main agent: keep/extend new P0 regression files added this run for future guardrails (outbound + privacy boundary + evidence receipt/idempotency).
Main agent: physical-device validation still required for native packet/call-screening acceptance paths; web/Expo cannot prove OS-level enforcement.
Main agent: review legacy test fixtures that still include disallowed evidence fields (os_version/sdk_version/app/process/etc) under minimal privacy boundary.
critical_code_review_comments: services/outbound.py enforces strict target parsing (scheme/port/userinfo), global-IP-only DNS policy, pinned numeric socket with original Host/SNI, trust_env=False, no redirects auto-follow, no decompression, bounded body, and concurrency/timeouts.
core/privacy_boundary.py correctly fails closed with 403 before body parsing for disabled cloud-sensitive routes.

routers/patrol.py + services/patrol_policy.py correctly gate state='biting' to packet-backed evidence only, block call-category Biting, and enforce evidence receipt identity/fingerprint reuse protection.
frontend domain mapping (enforcementEvidenceSync.ts) now intentionally strips OS/SDK fingerprint fields (null) to match minimal privacy boundary contract.

success_rate.backend: New P0 regression suite: 23/23 passed (100%). Legacy targeted suites executed earlier had significant expected failures from obsolete assertions tied to pre-P0 behavior.
success_rate.frontend: Executed suites this run: failureModes/protectionTruth/gate1/gate2/gate3/gate3page/gate4/gate5/gate6/gate7/gate8/share/evidence-sync all passing after test expectation updates; mobile web regression navigation passed.

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed fixtures added. Temporary test events/devices created via /api/devices/register and patrol endpoints only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials file was read and followed (/app/memory/test_credentials.md). Device registration bearer flow used (no email/password auth). Web preview indicates SecureCore implementation is MOCKED; do not claim native enforcement proof from web. Cloud-sensitive flows are intentionally blocked by policy and should be asserted as 403, not treated as outages.
rca_of_issue: Primary failures observed in pre-existing suites were expectation drift after P0 local-first hardening: older tests still post raw message/account bodies, page crawl, IMAP scans, and breach/caller lookups expecting old statuses. Additional mismatch came from legacy evidence fixtures including now-forbidden fields and timestamp mismatches for packet-backed Biting. Added replacement regressions to validate current contracts directly.
